sandstone.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a seamless tileable 2048x2048 square albedo texture for a high quality 3D game terrain, covering approximately 12 metres of eroded desert sandstone cliff face. Primary request: original realistic weathered sandstone bedrock, large angular interlocking rock slabs, irregular broken sedimentary ledges and vertical fissures, densely detailed mineral granulation and spalled surfaces. Color palette muted grey taupe, sandy beige, pale ochre, scattered subtle iron oxide brown; natural low saturation desert geology. Composition: perfectly straight-on orthographic full frame stone surface from edge to edge; no perspective, no horizon, no scenery, no objects, no frame. Lighting: extremely diffuse neutral overcast illumination, no directional highlights, no strong baked shadows, physically useful as a base-color map. Irregular scale: a few metre-wide broad stone faces and many fine fractures, coherent geological formations, never bricks or a stacked wall. Seamlessly repeat at all four edges. No text, labels, watermark, vegetation or grass.
